summary: Full test of XOK'S Custom Studio (backend + frontend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_custom_studio.py (14 tests) covering products/sections, photo upload/download, and Stripe checkout server-side price recomputation; fixed stale product-count expectation in backend_test.py. Full suite: 45/45 pass. Frontend: /custom-studio landing (hero, 3 carbon options, 2 tiers, active-state cyan borders, live total 92.90/97.90/109.90, CTA -> /custom-studio/build?tier&carbon), /custom-studio/build (size selector, name/number/notes, 2 slots for base & 4 for pro, JPG/PNG upload with preview+filename, both validation toasts block submit, add-to-cart -> /checkout with correct 109.90/97.90 totals), /produtos 3 sections + Personalizar -> build with tier param, /produto/studio-pro auto-redirect, homepage CTA -> /custom-studio. Full E2E paid flow: base+twill custom item -> Stripe checkout page shows line 'Studio Base · TEST E2E #9 · Twill · Tam. S' €97.90; order XOKS-1020 created with status pending_payment and full custom_data; /admin expands the order and shows Carbono/Nome/Número/Observações + working photo link (/api/uploads/file/{id} returns 200 image/png). Zero console errors on all pages.

issues: 'MAIS ESCOLHIDO' badge overlaps the 'ADVANCED CUSTOM' tagline text on both desktop (1920) and mobile (390) — badge is absolutely positioned top-right over the text column; move badge above image or add right padding to the tagline
custom_data labels use text-zinc-500 on #0d0d0d background — low contrast for key order info (Carbono/Nome/Número); consider zinc-400 or lighter

action_items: Optional: fix 'MAIS ESCOLHIDO' badge overlap on Studio Pro tier card
Optional: add data-testid="custom-studio-banner-cta" (spec mentioned it; only home-custom-studio-cta exists — the CTA itself works)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py upload_custom_photo defines unused variable backend_base (dead code, line ~498).

seed() only uses $setOnInsert so price/spec changes to SEED_PRODUCTS never propagate to an existing DB; future edits to studio-base/studio-pro prices will silently not apply (pre-existing issue, same as iteration 13).

Checkout carbon delta map is hardcoded in server.py and duplicated in CustomStudio.jsx/CustomStudioBuild.jsx; a mismatch would silently change price. Consider serving deltas from the backend (e.g. product.custom_options).
server.py is 813 lines — consider splitting routers (products/orders/checkout/uploads) into modules.
Unknown carbon values silently fall back to +0€ (verified). Acceptable but a 400 would be safer against tampering.
seed_data_creation: Created ~6 TEST_ pending_payment orders via /api/checkout (XOKS-1015..1020) and several uploaded TEST_ photos in object storage. No delete endpoint for orders/files, so they remain but are prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline is now 7 products (4 originals + xoks-carbon-legacy + studio-base + studio-pro). Custom Studio flow fully verified end-to-end incl. Stripe redirect. Photo upload testid is on the LABEL, so use set_input_files('[data-testid="photo-left-input"] input[type="file"]'). Order XOKS-1020 is a good admin fixture with full custom_data.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found; only two cosmetic design nits (badge overlap, low-contrast admin labels).
